scalars.appr_root_cause: Stuck bill-payments are auto-generated (createdby = System) with nextApprover unassigned (-1): the workflow created the payment but never routed it to an approver, so it sits in 'Pending Approval' indefinitely. The bills themselves are Open/approved and awaiting these payments. Master-data: as of 15 Jul ALL active customers (14,356) and vendors (1,035) are Approved — 0 pending. The 27 Jun pending list has since been approved; C-02347 & C-7492369 are Rejected / pending-but-inactive, not live approvals. Separately, 129 Journal Entries sit in Pending Approval (mostly AUTO intercompany Inbox/ACT recharges) — a systemic auto-JE backlog to review, not a payment blocker.
scalars.nodue_note: 16 bills Open + Approved but missing a due date, so the KBank run skips them. Fix = re-apply the term to populate the due date; no re-approval needed.
scalars.prepay_note: Open bills on Prepayment terms — clear by applying the deposit, not the bank run. 13 bills (฿59,148) are >30 days past the bill date; โอซูก้า (9 bills ฿51,809) is the bulk.
scalars.pm_note: This account has NO NetSuite Vendor Prepayment (VPrep) module. Vendor deposits are booked to GL 11037002 เงินมัดจำ and cleared against bills two ways: netted inside the vendor bill, or applied to an AP bill via Journal. Both = a bill paid by prepayment (not by bank/KBank). Mostly fit-out/construction deposits (Subway, Juice Land, Very Thai, Pony On Wheel).
